section: M1.8 routed audio options and preference upgrade
scope: Actual Unreal/host/audio-device/controller/Windows acceptance. No rows executed in this source-delivery environment.

tests.procedure: Start the retained host without an Audio Options component.
tests.expected: Audio fields are unavailable; text, compatible look/sprint controls, New and Continue retain their existing behavior.

tests.procedure: Add the component with default opt-in false.
tests.expected: No mix is created/pushed and no volume command is issued. An options warning explains missing routing.

tests.procedure: Try initialization on a pawn, director, nonlocal controller or networked/split-screen world.
tests.expected: Initialization refuses without selecting a substitute owner/device.

tests.procedure: Add two audio-options components to the local controller before UI initialization.
tests.expected: UI initializes neither; no duplicate mix multiplication.

tests.procedure: Bind only zero, one or two of the three actual classes.
tests.expected: All four volume fields remain unavailable. No class asset/path is invented.

tests.procedure: Assign one class to more than one category.
tests.expected: Read validation refuses aliases rather than allowing one category to overwrite another.

tests.procedure: Supply a class with a parent or child; repeat with passive modifiers.
tests.expected: Unsupported hierarchy/passive modifier is rejected. No asset is changed to make it pass.

tests.procedure: Check volume outside [0,1], pitch outside (0,4], NaN/infinity via a disposable native fixture.
tests.expected: Invalid metadata is rejected before issuing audio commands.

tests.procedure: Run the real host with audio disabled or an unavailable audio device.
tests.expected: Audio controls stay unavailable; no successful playback claim; campaign behavior remains independent.

tests.procedure: Route actual owned ambience, effects and radio sounds to the three dedicated independent classes, then opt in before startup.
tests.expected: Native command readiness is available. Audibly verify each sound is actually affected; the opt-in alone is not acceptance.

tests.procedure: Persist Master=0, relaunch and start actual sound sources only after UI/options initialization.
tests.expected: Mix begins with saved zero multipliers and zero startup fade; no intentional full-volume burst. Inspect actual device behavior.

tests.procedure: Use two missing preference slots and correct sound routing.
tests.expected: All volumes default 100%; no automatic preference write or automatically started sound.

tests.procedure: Change all four volumes in the options draft, then Back.
tests.expected: Audible mix/live values/files do not change; parent focus returns.

tests.procedure: Apply Master=50, Ambience=20, Effects=100, Radio=0 for session only.
tests.expected: Submitted multipliers are .1, .5, 0. No preference write; actual playback matches configured routing after interpolation.

tests.procedure: Use Master=50 and each channel=50.
tests.expected: Each routed class gets .25, not .125 or .5. Independent categories do not receive a parent master a second time.

tests.procedure: Mute each channel separately while sounds on the other two continue.
tests.expected: Only the selected routed class is muted; verify all actual cue/wave/class overrides.

tests.procedure: Choose distinct channel levels, set Master=0 then restore Master=100.
tests.expected: Mute does not discard category settings; unmute restores those settings rather than resetting everything to 100.

tests.procedure: Mute/unmute a looping ambience asset and a finite radio source with the actual virtualization/concurrency policy.
tests.expected: No epsilon mute is substituted. Configure/record whether loops continue, resume or restart; the component does not manufacture stopped voices.

tests.procedure: Repeatedly open/apply/close options while tracking sound spawning and radio tokens.
tests.expected: No sound is spawned/stopped/replayed by the volume component and no transcript is acknowledged.

tests.procedure: Play the complete First Signal mission with Master/Radio=0 or no audio owner.
tests.expected: Full transcript remains readable. Explicit Continue completes the message; no audio-finished callback gates or grants progress.

tests.procedure: Use keyboard/mouse and controller-only to cycle all ten fields and adjust 0 through 100.
tests.expected: Five-percent bounds hold, existing six field indices/order remain, one command per frame, and settings require no mouse drag.

tests.procedure: Inspect all native screens at 1920x1080/1280x720 and 100%/150% text.
tests.expected: Ten-row options body, error messages and all controls scroll and focus correctly; no hidden required command.

tests.procedure: Apply valid preferences from Session/Pause while the world is paused.
tests.expected: Audio commands are submitted without changing pause/input ownership. Actual paused source playback follows host policy.

tests.procedure: Set session-only audio, switch campaigns through New/Continue and test recovery.
tests.expected: The local audio mix and values persist without repushing. Campaign epochs do not recreate preference/mix owners.

tests.procedure: Load a backed-up schema1 pair and explicitly save new options.
tests.expected: Five values preserved, Hold sprint and 100% volumes default. No load write; explicit verified save writes schema3 to inactive slot.

tests.procedure: Load backed-up schema2 preferences with Toggle then explicitly save changed volumes.
tests.expected: All six values preserved, volumes default 100%; explicit schema3 write increments generation and retains prior valid slot.

tests.procedure: Inject no-write, partial/corrupt, unreadable readback and valid-write/failure-return cases into disposable platform slots.
tests.expected: No unverified write updates live values or applies new mix values. Further writes block; valid bytes that reached disk may load after relaunch.

tests.procedure: Test mixed1/2/3 generations, equal generations, unsupported future schema, all-corrupt and read-error slots.
tests.expected: Highest unambiguous valid generation only; ambiguous/unsupported/read errors never authorize overwrite or silent reset.

tests.procedure: Modify a disposable preference peer after load but before explicit save.
tests.expected: Observed-file check blocks write/apply; session-only remains available. No OS-lock/crash-safety guarantee is inferred.

tests.procedure: Remove/invalidates the audio binding after changing audio draft fields, then Apply/Save.
tests.expected: Changed audio fields are refused before applying/saving when unavailability is observed. Reopen options for available fields.

tests.procedure: Change the world audio device while the initialized owner ticks.
tests.expected: Feature disables and releases only its mix on the original device, not a mix on the replacement. No automatic rebind or campaign write.

tests.procedure: Apply unchanged values repeatedly; also change only text or masked channels while Master=0.
tests.expected: No repeated push and no redundant effective-gain updates. Stored masked channel preferences still change for future unmute.

tests.procedure: Close UI/session, unregister/remove audio owner and end PIE in varied orders.
tests.expected: Pop occurs at most once, on the captured device. Other mixes and sound-class asset properties remain untouched; no retained owner leak.

tests.procedure: Run a deliberate separate mix against unrelated classes, and separately an intentionally conflicting same-class modifier.
tests.expected: Unrelated mix is preserved. Same-class independent modifiers can combine; record this unsupported ownership conflict instead of claiming conflict detection.

tests.procedure: Against backed-up disposable files, inspect older M1.6/M1.7 reader behavior after schema3 save.
tests.expected: Old readers reject the new schema. Rollback restores a backed-up old pair outside play; unrelated campaigns are not removed.

tests.procedure: Build/cook Windows, launch outside the editor and perform full New -> pickup -> storage -> repair -> transcript -> return -> verified save -> exit/relaunch -> Continue.
tests.expected: Campaign/inventory remain coherent and preferences restore separately. Record real versions, logs, audio/routing observations and screenshots.
